requirements.description: Bind SN74LVC1G14DBVR or SN74LVC1G17DBVR and suitable 0402 bypass; preserve exact managed footprints, capacitor decoupling role and consumer positive-pad bound. Confirm capacitance, voltage rating and effective capacitance for actual rail.
Host owns IC ground pin 3, signals and complete local return loop. Connect IC ground locally to continuous ground planes; macro owns only capacitor ground lead/via.
Require full consumer native filled-board DRC, surface bypass verification, plane connectivity and assembly review. Do not route other load or switch current through this local bypass branch.
Host logic signals and unused pins, supply integrity, complete return path and EMI qualification remain open.
